system.description:
Effect: Until you use a one-hour or longer recovery, anyone within melee range striking you automatically takes 2 damage (no action or roll needed). The source of this damage depends on the cypher; some create a burst of electricity or fire, some inject a toxin or destructive nanites, and others temporarily cover your body with spikes or sharp scales.

Genre Items: fire shield rune (fantasy); deterrence field (sci-fi)
